Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: "FIXT.1.1" This must be the first field in the message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: The length of the FIX message. This must be the second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: The type of message. This must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: The sender's id, assigned at on-boarding time.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: MPID of the originating firm if this message is being delivered by a third party(i.e. sponsored access).

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: MPID of the firm targeted to receive this message. This tag will be sent on any responses where the original request contained a value in OnBehalfOfCompID(115).

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: The message sequence number.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: The time of message transmission in Universal Time coordinated. See UTCTimestamp in FIX 5.0 SP2 specification.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Always required for retransmitted messages, whether prompted by the sending system or as the result of a resend request.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Required when message may be duplicate of another message sent under a different sequence number.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for message resent as a result of a ResendRequest. If data is not available set to same value as SendingTime.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: The message checksum. This must be the last field in the message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier included in Test Request message to be returned in resulting Heartbeat.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Required to be 0.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval, in seconds. An interval of 0 indicates there are no heartbeats. The maximum supported interval is 90 seconds.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: The exchange will reject logon if this flag is 'Y'. Market operations can reset the inbound and outbound sequence numbers upon request.

Field.Name: DefaultApplVerID
Field.Description: Required to be 9. ("FIX50SP2")

Field.Name: DefaultCstmApplVerID
Field.Description: The schema version, required as of version 1.9, is used to ensure consistency across message formats.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text explaining reason for logout.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: Reference message sequence number.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: The tag number of the FIX field that was rejected.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message that was rejected.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Explanatory reason.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates that this message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier included in Test Request message to be returned in resulting Heartbeat.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: Reference message sequence number.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a Business Message Reject message.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Explanatory reason.

Field.Description: Quantity ordered. This represents the number of shares. The maximum order size permitted is 1,000,000 shares. The maximum notional value permitted is $30,000,000

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Type of the order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price per unit of quantity (e.g. per share).

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Defines the time during which an order is eligible for execution.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Designates the capacity of the firm placing the order.

Field.Name: CustOrderCapacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the customer placing the order. If not specified, behavior defaults to MemberTradingOnTheirOwnAccount.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Instructions for order handling on the exchange. If more than one instruction is required then separate each character by a space.

Field.Name: ExtendedExecInst
Field.Description: Additional instructions for order handling on exchange. If more than one instruction is required, then separate each character by a space.

Field.Name: PegOffsetValue
Field.Description: Amount (signed) added to the peg for a pegged order.

Field.Name: PegPriceType
Field.Description: Defines the type of peg.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Time/Date of order expiration, this is the expiration time of a GoodForTime TimeInForce. If omitted, expiration time will be set to the end of the post-market trading session. This is in FIX UTCTimestamp format.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum quantity of an order to be executed.

Field.Name: DisplayQty
Field.Description: Quantity of the order to be displayed.

Field.Name: DisplayMethod
Field.Description: Defines the replenishment size behavior for a reserve order. Selecting 'Undisclosed' will result in a fully hidden order. This tag should be specified for Pegged and Market orders. This tag should not be specified for fully displayed Limit orders. Currently if this tag is not specified for a Pegged or Market order the default value shall be Undisclosed. This is not recommended as this behavior may change in a future revision of the specification.

Field.Name: ReserveReplenishTime
Field.Description: Defines the replenishment timing behavior for a reserve order. This is a custom tag.

Field.Name: DisplayMinIncr
Field.Description: Defines the minimum increment to be used when calculating a random refresh of DisplayQty.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: UTCTimestamp since epoch with millisecond precision.

Field.Name: LocateReqd
Field.Description: Required on Short Sell and Short Sell Exempt orders only. Only acceptable value is 'N' which indicates the member has secured the required locate.

Field.Name: RepriceFrequency
Field.Description: Defines the frequency of a reprice. If this tag is not sent then the order will not be repriced. This is a custom tag.

Field.Name: RepriceBehavior
Field.Description: Reprice behavior when market is locked or crossed. This is a custom tag.

Field.Name: StpGroupID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of self trade prevention group.

Field.Name: SelfTradePrevention
Field.Description: Defines the desired behavior in the event of a wash. This is a custom tag.

Field.Name: RiskGroupID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of a custom risk control set to be applied to this order. This is a custom tag.
